pages.text: The $(thing)Prospector's Drill$() is unique from other prospecting tools in that its scanning area is not a cube and not centered on the clicked block.$(br)The scan area is a 7x25x7 box where the square faces are parallel to the clicked face. Additionally, the scan area is shifted away from the clicked face by 10 blocks.
pages.title: Prospector's Drill

pages.text: A mold for the tool head can be $(l:getting_started/pottery)knapped$() from clay, as seen above, which can be used to $(l:getting_started/finding_ores#casting)cast$() low tier metals.
A $(thing)Prospector's Drill Head$() can also be $(l:mechanics/anvils#working)smithed$() out of a $(thing)tuyere$() of any tool metal.
The head can then be crafted with two sticks to make a Prospector's Drill
